3682-5660-6769-6798.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one colored legendary creature or planeswalker.
Evolution Witness has a +1/+1 counter on it.
3682-5660-6769-6798.description:
Cast Mox Amber by paying its mana cost.
When Mox Amber enters, Surge Conductor triggers.
Holding priority, activate Mox Amber by tapping it, adding one mana of any color among legendary creatures and planeswalkers you control.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Mox Amber, causing you to surveil 1.
Resolve the Surge Conductor trigger, causing you to proliferate, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Mox Amber from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-2033-3249-3841--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2033-3249-3841--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Citanul Hierophants by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Citanul Hierophants by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Torens triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

222-527-5223-6495.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-5223-6495.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Evereth twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.
222-527-5223-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1981-2415-6720-8095.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-6720-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Case of the Uneaten Feast triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

553-5858-7468.description:
During the opponent's end step immediately before your turn, cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W} using Gandalf.
In response, cast Swat Away by paying its mana cost, putting Approach of the Sun on top of your library.
In your draw step, draw Approach of the Second Sun.
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, winning the game.

3249-5173-5256-5921.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Shambling Ghast card from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}
Repeat.

3587-5178-7711.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to deal damage to Red Hulk.
You control a creature that has indestructible.
3587-5178-7711.description:
Give Red Hulk and Boros Reckoner indestructible using Odric.
Deal damage to Red Hulk.
Red Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and dealing damage to Boros Reckoner.
Boros Reckoner triggers, dealing damage to Red Hulk.
Repeat from step 3.
3587-5178-7711.notes: The final instance of damage can be flung at an opponent for infinite damage. If you can deal more damage to Red Hulk afterwards, you can deal infinite damage to more targets.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5189-5686-6972.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Ghave.
When Ghave dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Etali, Primal Conqueror // Etali, Primal Sickness

2178-4147-4294-5686.easyPrerequisites:
Hua Tuo does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Hua Tuo.
2178-4147-4294-5686.description:
Cast Etali by paying {5}{R}{R} and paying any commander tax if relevant.
When Etali enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Etali.
If Etali is your commander, choose not to return it to the command zone from your graveyard.
When Etali dies, Hua Tuo triggers, untapping Hua Tuo.
Activate Hua Tuo by tapping it, putting Etali on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from Step 3.
Resolve the Etali trigger from step 2, causing you to exile cards from each player's library until you exile a nonland card, with you exiling Etali from your library.
Cast Etali and any other nonland cards exiled this way without paying their mana costs.
Repeat from Step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5256-6730-6972.notablePrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature with base toughness 2 or greater that does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
5256-6730-6972.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the additional creature.
When the creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Sin.
When Sin dies, it triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, returning Sin from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it. As Sin enters, remove the -1/-1 counter from the creature sacrificed in step 1, causing Sin to enter with a +1/+1 counter on it instead.
Resolve the second Sin trigger, putting the counters it had on it when it was sacrificed onto a creature you control and failing to shuffle it into your library as it's no longer in your graveyard.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 4.
Repeat.

2440-3581-6791-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
Kykar triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Spirit you control.
Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Spirit token.
Activate the Spirit token by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature a returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
2440-3581-6791-7109.notes: The cost can be reduced to as little as {1} if you control other Spirits. You can also sacrifice the Spirits once you have enough to get infinite {R}.

2440-6968-7108-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
Sokka's second ability and each Ally you control's prowess ability trigger.
Resolve all prowess triggers, giving each Ally you control +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Sokka trigger, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When the Ally enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Ally you control.
Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Ally token.
Activate the Ally token by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature a returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
2440-6968-7108-7109.notes: The cost can be reduced by {1} if you control another Ally.

643-2921-5310-6879.description:
Cast Bloodghast by paying {B}{B}.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Bloodghast.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing a land creature.
When the land creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.
643-2921-5310-6879.notes: If the chosen land can enter untapped and produce mana, you may do so each iteration to get infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).

475-549-2919-3197.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
475-549-2919-3197.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating at least one artifact creature token.
Leonin Elder triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

3901-5109-6899.description:
Cast Volcano Hellion by paying {2}{R}{R}.
When Volcano Hellion enters, it triggers, dealing an arbitarily large amount of damage to you and a creature. The damage that would be dealt to you is dealt to Wrathful Red Dragon instead due to With Great Power....
Wrathful Red Dragon triggers, dealing an arbitrarily large amount of damage to an applicable target.

1651-2073-4779-6757--90.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning the noncreature artifact with mana value 1 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the noncreature artifact enters the battlefield, Weapons Manufacturing triggers, creating a Munitions artifact token.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the noncreature artifact returned in step 1 and the Munitions token, untapping Salvaging Station.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing the noncreature artifact.
Repeat.
1651-2073-4779-6757--90.notes: You can sacrifice the Munitions to get infinite damage if desired. If the noncreature artifact chosen can sacrifice itself without tapping or additional costs, you can omit the sacrifice outlet, but will forego the possibility of infinite damage.

4772-5658-6245-6753.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You have the city's blessing or control at least six permanents.
4772-5658-6245-6753.description:
Declare Satya as an attacker. Satya triggers, creating four token copies of Ocelot Pride that are tapped and attacking and causing you to get {E}{E}.
If you don't have the city's blessing, the Ocelot Pride token gives you the city's blessing.
At the beginning of your end step, Satya triggers four times, and each Ocelot Pride you control triggers once.
Resolve the first Ocelot Pride trigger, causing you to create three 1/1 Cat creature tokens if you gained life this turn, and then causing you to create three token copies of each creature token that entered the battlefield under your control this turn, and then causing you to create a token copy of each noncreature token that entered the battlefield under your control this turn.
Repeat step 4 for each remaining trigger.
4772-5658-6245-6753.notes: You may repeat this loop during subsequent turns to get even more creature tokens and ETB triggers.

513-527-1849.notablePrerequisites:
You have a creature card in hand that can be cast using only colored mana.
Selvala can tap to produce at least {1}{G}{G}{G} plus enough mana to cast the other creature card.
513-527-1849.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{G}{G}{G} plus enough mana to cast a creature card from your hand.
Cast a creature card by paying its mana cost.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying {1}{G}{G}.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning the creature cast in step 2 from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1497-2169-3327-4613.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
1497-2169-3327-4613.description:
Activate Zameck Guildmage's first ability by paying {G}{U}.
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Zameck Guildmage.
Activate Dargo using Wild Cantor's ability by sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Repeat from step 2.

488-641-1482-4708-4986.notablePrerequisites: One of either Dark Sphere or Jeweled Lotus must be in your hand, with the other in your graveyard.
488-641-1482-4708-4986.description:
Cast the artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Kroxa from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Kroxa enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities and Loran trigger.
Resolve the first Kroxa trigger, sacrificing it.
Resolve the second Kroxa trigger, causing each opponent to discard a card and lose 3 life if they didn't discard a nonland card.
Resolve the Loran trigger, returning the other {0} cost artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the spell cast in step 1.
Activate the {0} cost artifact by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

4824-5457-5963.notablePrerequisites: Marvin does not have summoning sickness.
4824-5457-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Selvala's ability by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Marvin using Soliton's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

640-2161-3490-4659.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one artifact creature.
640-2161-3490-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing an artifact creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Dross Harverster's second ability triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Scion of the Swarm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

1818-2034-2173-5010.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 3.
1818-2034-2173-5010.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Golgari Thug.
When Golgari Thug dies, it triggers, putting it from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Golgari Thug from the top of your library by paying 2 life.
When Golgari Thug enters, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

539-4131-4178-4241.notablePrerequisites: Basalt Monolith does not have summoning sickness.
539-4131-4178-4241.description:
Activate Karn by paying {1}, causing Basalt Monolith to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Nissa triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Basalt Monolith's second ability by paying {3}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

132-198-1247.notablePrerequisites: Myr Welder does not have summoning sickness.
132-198-1247.description:
Activate Myr Welder using Empowered Autogenerator's ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Myr Welder and adding one mana of any color for each charge counter on Myr Welder.
Activate Myr Welder using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

323-1263-3479-4050.notablePrerequisites: You attacked with a creature this turn.
323-1263-3479-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion, adding {B}.
Falkenrath Noble and Life Insurance triggers.
Resolve the Falkenrath Noble trigger, causing target player to lose 1 life and gaining you 1 life.
Resolve the Life Insurance trigger, causing you to lose 1 life and creating a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing itself, adding {B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

791-2290-3062.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 4.
791-2290-3062.description:
Activate Unspeakable Symbol by paying 3 life, putting two +1/+1 counters on Spike Feeder.
Activate Spike Feeder's second ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat.

1987-2427-4125-5116.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Gilded Lotus and Shipwreck Dowser, blinking them.
When Shipwreck Dowser enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
Repeat.
